component_setup_note: First direct unit invocation did not collect tests because the pinned security source was absent from PYTHONPATH; after supplying the existing pinned source, 7 metric regressions passed. No dependency version substitution.
limitations: Normal ready-target v3 and owner-loss v2 have different fault models, not an identical-condition improvement comparison
One closed-loop run per case; retry delays change actual arrival timing; not a statistical SLO estimate
One local arm64 kind node and one isolated PG17.12 server with separate databases, not AWS-to-independent-onprem migration
Synthetic plan/bootstrap IdP/local file witness/shared fixture DB certificate, no production WORM, customer identity or release qualification
Final SQL consistency does not erase first-attempt errors, attempt exhaustion or post-load completion delays
Ready health and a matching target label do not imply zero route propagation time or permit target writes before activation
Some plan/gate evidence is synthetic fixture input; HANDOFF_COMPLETE and fixture availability.client_completion_wait=pass do not override the independently measured client outcome
